2.16.15
Textbox.Visibility
The Textbox.Visibility element specifies whether a Textbox is hidden. This element is optional. This
element is of type Visibility.
Following is the parent element of the Textbox.Visibility element.
Parent elements
Textbox
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Textbox.Visibility element.
 <xsd:element name="Visibility" type="VisibilityType" minOccurs="0" />
